Everything runs on your phone. Your files are never uploaded.
Resize and compress photo and signature to exam rules

Scan documents to PDF and copy text
ATS resumes from 15 templates, plus marriage and portfolio biodata, as PDF or Word
Mr File Fixit is free, has no ads, no accounts and no sign-in. Here is what happens to your files:
Image compression, cropping, PDF tools, scanning and text recognition all run on your phone\'s own processor.
The app has no internet permission, so Android itself stops it from sending anything. There are no ads, analytics or servers, and your documents, photos and extracted text never leave your phone.
Working copies are kept in the app\'s private cache and deleted when you leave a tool. Anything left behind when the app is closed is removed the next time it starts.
Location, camera details and other EXIF data are stripped from images when you export them.
